stories.title: Il gioielliere Roggero: "Potevo essere meno impulsivo e riflessivo"

en.title: Jeweler Roggero: "I could have been less impulsive and more reflective"
en.summary: A jeweler condemned to 14 years and 9 months made spontaneous statements before a Surveillance Court, with his lawyer indicating plans to contest the rejection of a sentence deferment request.

stories.title: Gaza, crolla un palazzo: “Almeno cento persone tra le macerie, tra cui 50 bambini”

en.title: Gaza, building collapses: "At least one hundred people in the rubble, including 50 children"
en.summary: A building previously damaged by Israeli bombardments but still standing collapsed in Gaza, where it had sheltered displaced residents. Relief efforts face obstacles due to lack of heavy excavation equipment.

stories.title: Abusi su un turista minorenne, arrestato custode degli Scavi di Pompei

en.title: Abuse of a minor tourist, custodian of Pompeii Excavations arrested
en.summary: A custodian at the Pompeii archaeological site was arrested for abusing a minor tourist after posing as a tour guide and bringing the victim to a closed area.

stories.title: Roggero, potevo essere meno impulsivo e più riflessivo

en.title: Roggero, I could have been less impulsive and more reflective
en.summary: A jeweler appearing before a Surveillance Court reflected on his past conduct, emphasizing that every life deserves respect.

stories.title: Drone russo su minibus 5 morti. Fbi: "Russia pianifica omicidi mirati in Usa ed Europa"

en.title: Russian drone strikes minibus killing 5; FBI warns Russia plans targeted killings in US and Europe
en.summary: A Russian drone attack killed five people in a minibus. The FBI reported that Russia is planning targeted assassinations in the United States and Europe, while Russia has redeployed military ships to the Mediterranean and struck a passenger train between Kyiv and Mykolaiv.

stories.title: Soccer: Bologna sack Tedesco, bring in Palladino

en.title: Soccer: Bologna sack Tedesco, bring in Palladino
en.summary: Bologna has removed manager Domenico Tedesco and appointed Raffaele Palladino as his replacement on a contract through 2029. Palladino previously managed Fiorentina, Atalanta, and Monza.

stories.title: Bologna, esonerato Tedesco: arriva Palladino con contratto fino al 2029

en.title: Bologna dismisses Tedesco; Palladino arrives with contract until 2029
en.summary: Bologna terminated Domenico Tedesco's management after four Serie A matches marked by poor results and lack of tactical identity. Raffaele Palladino has been appointed as the new manager.

stories.title: Avigliano dice addio a Zitòn, era l'uomo più anziano d'Italia a 112 anni

en.title: Avigliano says farewell to Zitòn, Italy's oldest man at 112 years old
en.summary: Vitantonio Lovallo, Italy's oldest citizen at 112, has died in his hometown of Avigliano. A lifelong farmer, he was recognized by Coldiretti as their longest-serving member.

stories.title: Precipita elicottero della Nbc Los Angeles, era impegnato nelle riprese di un incidente: tre morti

en.title: NBC Los Angeles helicopter crashes during filming of accident scene: three dead
en.summary: A helicopter crashed and caught fire in Chatsworth, a residential neighborhood of Los Angeles. Three people died in the incident, including one bystander.

stories.title: Scavi di Pompei, custode si finge guida e abusa di un turista 17enne. Arrestato

en.title: Pompeii site caretaker impersonates tour guide and abuses 17-year-old tourist. Arrested
en.summary: A caretaker at the Pompeii excavations falsely posed as a guide to isolate a teenage tourist, then committed assault. The incident occurred in mid-August.

stories.title: Roggero ci ripensa: “Il giorno della rapina avrei dovuto essere meno impulsivo”

en.title: Roggero reconsiders: "On the day of the robbery I should have been less impulsive"
en.summary: A jeweler reflected on his actions during a court hearing regarding a sentence deferment request, expressing philosophical remarks about human interconnection.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina-Russia, le news. Drone russo contro autobus di linea a Nikopol, 5 morti

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, news updates. Russian drone strikes bus in Nikopol, 5 dead
en.summary: Russian forces attacked a public bus in Nikopol, killing five people, and targeted a Kyiv-Mykolaiv train with passengers evacuated safely. The US reports Russian intelligence planned targeted killings in America and the EU.

stories.title: Fabbricati di categoria F, il vuoto normativo alimenta le incertezze sulle cessioni

en.title: Category F buildings, regulatory gap fuels uncertainty over transfers
en.summary: The Italian Notary Association has clarified VAT treatment and registration tax rules for category F buildings, addressing gaps in existing regulations affecting property transfers.

stories.title: Carta, il 20% delle aziende valuta la chiusura per il caro energia

en.title: Paper industry, 20% of companies considering closure due to energy costs
en.summary: Energy-intensive paper manufacturers are evaluating shutdowns as exponential cost increases continue, a trend previously seen during the 2022-2023 Russia-Ukraine conflict period.

stories.title: Zucchero, Eridania investe 20 milioni per potenziale la logistica e crescere nei dolcificanti

en.title: Sugar, Eridania invests 20 million to enhance logistics and grow in sweeteners
en.summary: Eridania, which holds significant market share in sugar retail sales and leads in sweeteners, is investing to strengthen its logistics capabilities.

stories.title: Carichi eccessivi? No grazie, la GenZ piuttosto lascia il lavoro

en.title: Excessive workloads? Gen Z prefers to leave their jobs
en.summary: A report shows Generation Z prioritizes work-life balance above all else, followed by job security, compensation, and career advancement opportunities.

stories.title: «L’Ai? Una grande chance per Pmi e sistema Italia»

en.title: "AI? A great opportunity for SMEs and the Italian system"
en.summary: Industry leaders argue that Italy's small and medium-sized enterprises possess characteristics well-suited to artificial intelligence adoption. They emphasize that while regulatory frameworks are necessary, the advancement of AI technology should not be hindered.
